notes.title: Elementallis FREE DEMO available during the IWOCon 2021
notes.content:
Hello Elementallists!

Elementallis is attending the IWOCon 2021, a FREE digital indie game convention! We will have a virtual booth at Love Islands. Come visit us!


 Visit the convention here!


During the convention, our demo will be public. Check out the first Temple in Elementallis and gather the FIre Element!

 Download the DEMO

notes.title: Live Stream with developer 📢
notes.content:
We will be playing the demo on a live stream on Saturday 20th at 8 AM PDT / 5 PM CEST

Join us to check the demo and ask us anything you want in the chat.

See you there!
~Iván

About the game

Elementallis is a top-down adventure inspired by the classics from Gameboy where the use of elements (fire, water, wind, earth...) enhances combat and is needed to solve puzzles.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/

notes.title: Chat with developer during Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614336/e3c275357a0da7efaa0ca86bde65cf7d8a9ae893.png


Play the demo when it launches on June 16th and then join us on Discord for a live chat with the developer to ask anything you want

When: Wednesday June 17th at 11 AM PDT / 8 PM CEST
Where: Our Discord server


The chat will last for roughly 2 hours, but I’ll also be available for questions during the Summer Festival, either on Discord, Twitter (@elementallis) or here on Steam. Feel free to say hello whenever you want!

Don’t forget to set a reminder by clicking the blue button. I hope to see you there!

~Iván
